baseline_notes.reference_adaptation: Odysseus workspace and agent concepts are retained as future boundaries, but the client shell is single-surface, touch-first, progressive-disclosure oriented, and intentionally lightweight for mobile PWA use.
baseline_notes.storage_notes: IndexedDB database mobile-agentic-ide, version 2, files and directories stores keyed by normalized relative path. Storage is same-origin and device-local; no backend sync is included.
baseline_notes.agent_notes: Handover payload format mobile-agentic-ide.handover.v1 is model-neutral and includes agentState, files, diffs, sessionHistory, and system/user messages. Provider keys are kept in a separate device-local IndexedDB vault; this is not hardware-backed encryption.
non_goals: Production service worker and offline synchronization
